findings.evidence: template/scripts/publication_state.py:223 unconditionally calls _protected_required_contexts for Requirement contributions; line 141 uses the branch-protection required_status_checks endpoint. That endpoint requires Administration read permission ([GitHub documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/branches/branch-protection#get-status-checks-protection)). However, .github/workflows/publication-queue.yml:42-43 explicitly grants the worker token only contents write and pull-requests write. publication_queue.py:1034 invokes this observer from that worker. Consequently, protection acquisition fails and returns unknown/transport rather than a passed required-checks gate, so even green contributions cannot advance to integration under the shipped coordinator credentials.
findings.summary: Contribution check observation requires a permission absent from the coordinator token, preventing contributions from progressing.
